THE SCENE

You are on a debate team, alone at your team's table. The Inca king lived in Cusco, high in the mountains. Could fish from the sea reach him in under two days? Your team says yes, and you must prove it with numbers. You need four facts. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This debate is about the Inca road in South America. Runners took turns carrying messages along the road. These runners were called chasquis. A Spanish writer said the king ate fresh sea fish.
